question: How do Unreal Blueprints actually evaluate, which of their graphs is for a living character, and which laws Gasper may steal versus must refuse?
coordinateSpaces: UE: Actor, EventGraph, ConstructionScript, AnimGraph, ControlRig. Pins: Exec (white), Data (typed color), Pose. Gasper: Contour512, phase φ, frame t. No exec token on the hull.
physicalLaw: Two pin families (Epic): Execution pins activate a node then fire an output exec. Data pins are type-specific; incompatible wires error. Function Call nodes have one exec in and one exec out.
Impure nodes have exec pins and run only when exec arrives. Pure nodes have no exec pin and recook once per data connection — a Random wired twice rolls twice (zomgmoz).
Latent nodes (Delay, async) create one latent action per node instance. Re-exec cancels the previous. Only the last Delay in a loop completes.
Construction Script runs on spawn / construction in editor. Event Graph runs after, on events (BeginPlay, Tick, input). They are different times, not two skins of one graph.

Anim Graph is not event-based. It evaluates every frame. Pose pins pass poses to Output Pose. Pulsing wires show continuous cook. Event Graph on an AnimBP only feeds values; it does not blend the pose.
Control Rig / deformer graphs are the character-shape instrument. Gameplay Event Graphs are not.
Data fan-out is legal. Exec typically has one next (branch/sequence are explicit). Auto-cast inserts a converter node. Alt-click breaks a pin.
artisticLaw: Do not put Event Tick on the 512. A walk is gait-law + handles, not a fired sequence of Set Actor Location.
Home / Identity is a Construction Script: authored once, restored, not ticked.
The Nodes page is an Anim Graph analog: contour/pose flows every frame toward Hull.
Takes are scores (Anim Notify / montage analog), not latent Delay chains on the hull.
A pure node that writes travel is a lie. Impurity must be visible or forbidden.
invariants: No exec / event / OnTick / Delay typeId on the hull graph.
Mute stays passthrough, not an exec skip.
Parent residual visual-scripting still holds: wires must carry typed data before they are a language.

One Blueprint to rule construction + tick + deform → mixer/language dual again.
